messages:
lina: Heads-up: Marketplace partners were notified the webhook signature algorithm will move from HMAC-SHA1 to HMAC-SHA256 next month. This will break SIs and some adaptor installers that only verify SHA1. We need a partner-safe migration plan.
aj: Do we know how many active webhook subscriptions still use the legacy header? rough numbers will help prioritize.
diego: Around 12 partner subscriptions and 7 marketplace adapters still send/verify X-Signature-SHA1. Several SI installers hardcode sha1 verification.
maya: Proposal: implement a gateway compatibility layer that accepts both signatures for a grace period. Behavior: if X-Signature-SHA256 present, validate normally; if only SHA1 present and partner is opted-in, validate SHA1 and add header "x-signature-bridged: sha1-accepted". Gate by partner_id/sku.
lina: Good. Can routing rules support a per-partner "accept_legacy_webhook_sig" flag? Also we should add telemetry so partners can see how many webhooks used the bridge.
aj: Yes 1 We can add routing config boolean "legacy_webhook_sig": true/false and emit metric tags "webhook.compat.sha1_accepted" and header "x-compat-webhook" when mapping happens. I'll wire up alerts for spikes in signature failures.
diego: Marketplace changes: add manifest key "legacy_webhook_signature_supported": true/false and surface a banner + opt-in toggle on listing. Also add an exportable report for partners listing which subscriptions still use sha1.
maya: SDKs: will ship small helper functions that detect both headers and verify accordingly, plus deprecation warning. Example snippet for comms:\n\n```\n// verify both header styles (JS example)\nconst sig256 = req.headers['x-signature-sha256']\nconst sig1 = req.headers['x-signature-sha1']\nif (sig256) verifyHMAC(body, sig256, secret, 'sha256')\nelse if (sig1) verifyHMAC(body, sig1, secret, 'sha1')\nelse reject(401)\n```\nKeep language-agnostic examples and link to SDK helpers.
lina: Timeline: enable gateway bridge behind per-partner flag immediately, announce 90-day deprecation window to partners, schedule canary: 2% partners for 48h -> 25% for 7d -> full. After 90 days, disable bridge for non-opt-ins.
aj: I'll draft runbook: watch for signature-failure rate, replay queue growth, and increased 5xxs from downstream apps. Rollback: flip routing flag off for impacted partners, and enable temporary replay mode. I'll create PagerDuty playbook entries.
diego: For SI partners, offer a migration toggle in marketplace console and 1:1 migration sessions for top 5 integrations. We'll also add an automated token exchange tool for those that need help rotating secrets.
partner-bot: Draft partner advisory scheduled for 2025-07-01 15:00 UTC (status: draft).
lina: Action items: aj -> routing flag + alerts + runbook; maya -> SDK helpers + deprecation warnings + PR; diego -> marketplace opt-in UI + exportable report + SI outreach; lina -> finalize partner advisory copy and legal review.
aj: I'll post the PR and runbook link here when ready.
maya: I'll include a short-lived metric "compat.webhook_sha1_count" and header "x-compat-webhook" so partners can opt into verbose logs.
lina: Thanks all. Let's aim to have the bridge and opt-in UI live at least a week before the vendor ship date. Posting follow-ups in #partnerships-ops. :thumbsup:
